daily.title: Mother tells of ‘unbearable’ grief for son murdered by 16yo
daily.summary: Jack Westren, who lived with a brain injury, was lured to Shellharbour Junction train station by a group of teenagers who violently ambushed him.

daily.title: 'I wasn't hiding anything': Lamarre-Condon's time in witness box ends
daily.summary: Following Beau Lamarre-Condon's time in the witness box ending, the Crown prosecutor read out a series of statements from Jesse Baird's brother and Luke Davies's mother related to evidence given by the accused.

daily.title: Breaking: Former federal minister Ken Wyatt named as WA's first Indigenous governor
daily.summary: The first Indigenous Australian elected to the House of Representatives achieves another historic first, being named as WA' s next governor.

daily.title: Judge rejects bid to keep Kmart child sex offender behind bars
daily.summary: Sterling Mervyn Free lured the child from her mother in the toy aisle of Kmart at Westfield North Lakes in December 2018.

daily.title: Mother of five children killed in house fire tells inquest 'fire was everywhere'
daily.summary: A mother whose five sons and partner died in a house fire on Russell Island has begun giving evidence at an inquest into their deaths.

daily.title: Four of our favourite potato recipes
daily.summary: From golden-roasted rosemary and garlic spuds and a vegetarian tray bake to a bright and punchy potato salad and a vegan gratin, we have something to suit all tastes.

daily.title: Coles investigates cyber attack but provides little detail
daily.summary: Coles has told customers to "remain vigilant" as it investigates a cyber incident, but says it has not identified customer or employee data being compromised at this stage.

daily.title: Police offer $500k reward for decade-old homicide case
daily.summary: Marlon McDonald was last seen at a police station on the New South Wales Mid North Coast in 2012, with a coroner ruling he likely died in suspicious circumstances.

daily.title: Breaking: Three Melbourne Cups won by Makybe Diva stolen from Flemington
daily.summary: The owner of the legendary mare says he is "totally devastated", after the three trophies were stolen in a brazen daylight robbery by men dressed in high-vis clothing.

daily.title: 'Absolute hero' intervenes as man suffers stroke while driving
daily.summary: An Adelaide man is being commended for quickly intervening to stop another driver who was swerving through lanes while suffering a medical episode.

daily.title: Murder accused faces court after fatal shooting in semi-rural Perth
daily.summary: A 38-year-old man charged with murder over the shooting death of a 44-year-old man in Perth's outer southern suburbs faces court for the first time.

daily.title: Racehorse So You Are dies of colic 13 days after running in Melbourne Cup
daily.summary: Trainer Bjorn Baker says the five-year-old horse, which finished eighth in the Melbourne Cup, was rushed to hospital but died following a severe bout of colic.

daily.title: Microsoft unlikely to compensate for loss of productivity
daily.summary: Millions were unable to use their Outlook email accounts on Friday, which halted many business operations. But don't expect a big cash payout for productivity loss.

daily.title: Hailstorm blankets Mudgee as giant hail warning issued for north-east NSW
daily.summary: Mudgee residents describe a lunchtime hailstorm so heavy that it left "snow drifts" in yards.

daily.title: Hells Angels bikie charged with threatening journalist Nick McKenzie
daily.summary: Police allege 36-year-old Kane Montebello sent a number of threatening, offensive and abusive text messages to investigative reporter Nick McKenzie.

daily.title: Court hears NT teen planned a 'massacre' at several locations
daily.summary: A teenage boy charged with terrorism-related offences allegedly wrote “that a massacre needs to happen”, naming potential locations including a church, a Northern Territory court has heard. The 14-year-old also allegedly had an Al-Qaeda training manual on his computer.

daily.title: Former defence employee with guns cache deemed high risk offender
daily.summary: A former defence employee who was "becoming radicalised" when police discovered a weapons cache at his Adelaide home must comply with dozens of strict conditions including a ban from any extremist activities.

daily.title: Two left stuck on Perth ferris wheel in the dark after ride turned off
daily.summary: Two people are left stranded at the top of a 36-metre-tall giant ferris wheel at Langley Park in the city's CBD on Saturday night, shining their mobile phone torches to draw attention before being rescued.

daily.title: Tug of war continues over mysterious foreign barge
daily.summary: About 10 months after an Indonesian barge drifted through the sea and ran aground on an Australian island, there is still no plan to salvage its rusting wreck.

daily.title: Russell Brand issues statement from prison saying he is not guilty
daily.summary: After being moved to a prison dedicated to housing sex offenders, convicted rapist Russell Brand issues a statement maintaining his innocence.

daily.title: Byron Bay girl stuns surfing world just days after turning 14
daily.summary: Leihani Zoric blitzes World Surfing Games to become youngest to ever win the open women's title.

daily.title: Advice panel gives conditional OK to controversial puberty blockers
daily.summary: Puberty blockers should remain a clinical option for certain children with gender dysphoria despite limited evidence about their benefits and harms, according to long-awaited national advice.

daily.title: Elderly driver who killed 4yo boy in Canberra avoids jail
daily.summary: An elderly driver who killed a four-year-old boy in Canberra's south earlier this year avoids jail time but has her licence suspended indefinitely.

daily.title: Neil the seal plan includes 'relocation' scenarios, vaccination options
daily.summary: Neil the seal could be relocated to Tasmania's west coast — or a remote island — if "unacceptable" risks arise during his visits, according to his new management plan.

daily.title: The artist subverting colonial history in her new photography show
daily.summary: Atong Atem's self-portraits are visually stunning, but it's their historic, political and philosophical depth that has made her a leading voice in the industry.

developing.title: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon explains why he threw Baird's phone off bridge

developing.summary: The Victorian Liberals are today dealing with the fallout of being forced to dump Williamstown candidate Paul Lindemann over offensive social media posts. Follow live.

developing.summary: Liberal leader Jess Wilson was spotted pouring beers in Wodonga last night, while the Carroll government has promised to freeze a tax on farmers if re-elected.

developing.title: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon answers questions in double murder trial
developing.summary: Beau Lamarre-Condon is continuing to answer questions after close to a week of cross-examination from the Crown.

developing.summary: Australia Test captain Pat Cummins is speaking to the media at Cricket NSW's headquarters about Usman Khawaja's recent revelations about Australia's ball tampering in 2018. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Jillaroos dominating World Cup final as Chapman leaps for stunning try
developing.summary: The Jillaroos and Kangaroos take on their New Zealand rivals in the women's and men's Rugby League World Cup finals. Follow live.

developing.summary: Unions and businesses groups sign an open letter calling for the federal parliament to back the government's proposed gas reservation scheme. Follow live.
